ability.name: Step 1 - Multi-Adapter CIDR Extraction
ability.description: Iterates over active network adapters and extracts valid subnet scopes to save network ranges dynamically.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $adapters=Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.PrefixLength -lt 32 }; $cidrs=@(); foreach($a in $adapters){ $b=([System.Net.IPAddress]$a.IPAddress).GetAddressBytes(); $mk=[System.BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]([Math]::Pow(2,32)-[Math]::Pow(2,32-$a.PrefixLength))); if([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian){[Array]::Reverse($mk)}; $net=(0..3|ForEach-Object{$b[$_]-band $mk[$_]}) -join '.'; $cidrs+="$net/$($a.PrefixLength)" }; $cidrs | Out-File C:\Windows\Temp\bas\network_cidrs.txt -Encoding ascii; if($cidrs.Count -gt 0){ $cidrs[0] | Out-File C:\Windows\Temp\bas\network_cidr.txt -Encoding ascii }; Write-Output "network.cidrs: $($cidrs | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)"; if($cidrs.Count -gt 0){ Write-Output "network.cidr: $($cidrs[0])" } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\step1.txt

rationale: Generates valid files on target system for multi-subnet sweeps, strictly preventing static variable hardcoding.
